verdict.rationale: Temporal's Schedule feature explicitly supports starting Workflow Executions at specific times, described as more flexible than cron jobs, with dedicated docs and CLI/UI support (temporal-docs-5, temporal-docs-23). This is corroborated by broad workflow/activity/retry infrastructure and community usage confirming production reliability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence specifically of Schedules working at scale, and no dedicated community discussion of the scheduling feature itself (most community quotes focus on workflows/activities generally, not Schedules).
